name: cohere-status-nonok
purpose: COHERE source, /status with a provider NON-2XX: pins the SHARED status tail this arm falls through to (:2143-2146), which answers status 200 with {error:true, data:{data:[]}} rather than forwarding the provider status or its error body.
stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.

tier2.rule: the value is compared as the literal "Bearer <synthetic cohere key>", never as a recorded secret
tier2.reason: the scenario declares the key it plants, so the value is the contract (a wrong secret NAME would send a different or no token)

tier2.rule: the recorder origin is replaced with <mock>
tier2.reason: The status arm assigns the hardcoded literal API_COHERE_V1, which is a DIFFERENT literal from the chat route's API_COHERE_V2 and lives outside it, so the pinned leg can only reach the recorder through the probe transport redirect and the Go leg through its own status seam. The PATH is untouched and IS compared.

tier3.reason: It is a measurement of elapsed wall-clock time, so it differs on every run and no backend can match it; the value is a duration, not a contract.
